content:
Last week saw notable price drops on several current Apple products, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the new AirPods Max 2, but the deals aren't over yet. While those discounts are still live, Amazon has just dropped the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 to its lowest price ever—just $20 each.

Last week we reported that the next-generation AirTag 2 had hit a record low as part of anniversary sales celebrations, but if you missed it, don't worry—the price has just dropped again to a new low, the best price we've ever tracked.

Amazon is still keeping the single AirTag 2 at $24, matching the best price since launch, but the four-pack has dropped to $79.99 with shipping included.

Apple's official four-pack retails for $99, which is already better value than buying singles at the regular $29; with the current additional discount of nearly 20%, it hits a new low of just $20 per AirTag 2.

While last week's $90 four-pack deal is almost certainly going to remain available across retailers during their anniversary sales, this new Amazon low is different—there's no telling when the price will go back up.

We've previously done a detailed comparison between the previous-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2—click here to check it out—here are the key highlights:

  • Precision Finding range extended up to 1.5x further
  • Volume boosted by up to 50% over the previous generation
  • You can hear AirTag 2 chime from up to twice the distance
  • Built-in "industry-first, comprehensive safeguards against misuse for stalking"

New AirTag 2 features coming soon

The deal dropping AirTag 2 to $20 each coincides with the launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27 next month. There's also good news for Apple Watch users: the Find My app is gaining Precision Finding support, letting you locate your AirTag using on-screen directional arrows and specific distance info right from your Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch was split across three separate app icons handling People, Items, and Devices.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 brings a refreshed design and interface improvements to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

With all this in mind, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 lineup—especially at this price point.

More Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2 at $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 at $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 at $99 (originally $129)
